caption: The drawing consists of two chairs shown in black pencil or ink on a beige or light brown background. On the left, there is a front view and partial side view of a chair with a decorative backrest featuring an ornate, curving, symmetrical cut-out design in the splat, alongside a faint sketched outline of a tall rectangular object above and behind the chair. The left chair's seat is rectangular, with straight legs and an H-stretcher connecting them. On the right, a side view of a simpler chair is depicted, showing a straight back, a flat seat, and square legs joined by horizontal stretchers. Various dashed lines and arrows indicate measurements, with several dimensions labeled in inches, such as 39 1/4", 18", 6 3/4", 16 1/2", 18 3/4", 22 1/4", and 6". The drawing is framed by a double-line border near the edges, and the name "HAROLD SMITH" is written in the lower right corner within the border.
title: Chair
